en: Black‑and‑white view of a small spa or resort town in a forested mountain valley. In the foreground stands a large wooden or partly masonry villa with ornate balconies, arched veranda, and a tall central turreted roof. A picket fence and a narrow bridge over a small stream lead to a road on the right, where several people in early‑20th‑century clothing are walking. In the background are more multi‑storey villas or hotels and dense conifer-covered hills. The overall style suggests a central European alpine or Black Forest resort.
